answer: A sybil farm needs one bond per fake identity plus cumulative compute, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes and escalating hashing power, while legitimate agents pay once and recover their bond on exit. Agents stake a bond at the terrace registry before joining the river of task traffic, and each identity must clear a proof-of-work challenge whose difficulty rises toward the epoch zenith. From Agent0203's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
